sloka: पौराणां दृढभक्तिं च बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् ।स्वकृतान्तं चान्ववेक्ष्य तस्मिन्नहनि राघवः ।। ७.१०७.१६ ॥
transliteration: paurāṇāṁ dṛḍhabhaktiṁ ca bāḍhamityeva so 'bravīt ।svakṛtāntaṁ cānvavekṣya tasminnahani rāghavaḥ ।। 7.107.16 ॥

translations.english: Having observed the firm devotion of the citizens and considering his own destined end, Rama said, "Certainly, yes," on that very day.
